name: kicad-vision-loop-agent
description: Iteratively assembles KiCad circuits from JSON definitions using a vision-thinking loop. Supports building new circuits and fixing existing ones.

skills.name: Circuit Assembly
skills.description: Assembles a complete KiCad schematic from a JSON circuit definition containing components and nets. Uses iterative place-wire-verify loop with vision verification.

skills.name: Circuit Repair
skills.description: Inspects an existing KiCad schematic, compares it to a target JSON circuit definition, and iteratively fixes discrepancies (missing components, broken wires, misplaced parts).
